anthropic.hint: Claude models through the Anthropic API.

gemini.hint: Google Gemini API; frames are sent inline.

openai.label: OpenAI-compatible
openai.hint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama or LM Studio server (no key needed; analyzed in small steps).

claudeCli.hint: Your claude CLI and its subscription; no API key.

codexCli.hint: Your codex CLI and its ChatGPT subscription; no API key.

standupReady.title: Your daily recap for yesterday is ready
standupReady.body: Tap to open it in Daily view.

firstCards.title: Your first Dayflow Electron cards are ready
firstCards.body: Take a look at what Dayflow Electron picked up from your last few minutes of work.

weeklyUnlocked.title: Weekly view is ready
weeklyUnlocked.body: Tap to open your weekly review.

available.title: Dayflow Electron {{version}} is available
available.bodyOpen: This copy can't install updates itself. Click to open the download page.

ready.title: Dayflow Electron {{version}} is ready
ready.body: Restart Dayflow Electron to update, or it updates the next time you quit.

macScreen.title: Screen Recording
macScreen.detail: Periodic screenshots let Dayflow Electron write your timeline for you.
macScreen.turnOn: Turn on Dayflow Electron in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, then quit and reopen the app.

linuxScreen.title: Screen sharing
linuxScreen.detail: Your desktop asks which screens to share. Choose all screens and allow restoring the permission, so it does not ask again. The app keeps only the screen under your mouse.

window.title: Window detection (optional)
window.detail: Blocked apps such as password managers are left out of recordings only where the app can see the active window.
window.detailFlatpak: Blocked apps such as password managers are left out of recordings only where the app can see the active window. In the Flatpak on KDE Plasma, run this command once, then restart the app.
window.detailUnavailable: Blocked apps such as password managers are left out of recordings only where the app can see the active window. Where it is not available, pause recording before opening a password manager.

windows.title: Nothing to allow
windows.detail: Windows needs no permission for screenshots. Recording starts as soon as you launch.

errors.locked: Chat unlocks after 10 hours of timeline data.

export.startAfterEnd: Start must be on or before end.

providers.cliFound: Found {{path}}. Click "Test connection" to check that you are logged in.
providers.cliNotFound: Not found. Install it, or enter its full path.
providers.cliNotFoundAt: Not found at {{path}}. Install it, or enter its full path.
